title: MCP servers
description: The tools agents reach through MCP, from their plugins, ~/.eta/mcp.json and project .mcp.json files; a later one replaces an earlier server of the same name. A project’s .mcp.json only applies in sessions in that project. Servers start on first use.

empty.title: No MCP servers
empty.description: Add servers to ~/.eta/mcp.json or a project’s .mcp.json.

override.detail: This plugin server is not started: the server of the same name in {{source}} is used instead.

login.title: Sign in to {{server}}
login.description: Approve access in the tab that opened. If it ends on a page that does not load, or on another computer, paste its address here.

logout.confirmDescription: Every agent that reaches this server loses the sign-in.
